content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MSc in Chemistry; PhD in Chemistry Age limit: Below 35 years (as on last date of receipt of application) Desirable: Demonstrated expertise in managing NMR spectroscopy facilities, including instrument operation and maintenance Spectral analysis and interpretation Development of NMR experiments Effective coordination with researchers and equipment suppliers Ensuring optimal instrument performance, reliability, and utilization through systematic maintenance and user support

content_sections.heading: JNCASR ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist/Instrument Scientist Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be expected to run NMR samples from external and internal users. Apart from this, they will be expected to develop, troubleshoot, and analyse spectra for both internal and external users. They will also be responsible for maintenance of the instrument and interfacing with the OEM as well as external users. The candidate should work collaboratively and collegially with the other NMR operator to ensure the smooth operation of the facility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Final remuneration is commensurate with experience, qualifications and documented proof of excellence; no other allowances admissible. The assignment will be purely on contract basis. Initial engagement would be for a period of six months and extendable on requirement and performance review.
